sentences.text: " 1. Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the entire proceeding of Case No. 0017 of 2021 (State of U.P. Vs. Vishvnath and Others), arising out of case crime No. 0200 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323 I.P.C. & 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, Police Station- Madhogarh,, District- Jalaun on the basis of compromise.

entities.text: Case No. 0017 of 2021 (State of U.P. Vs. Vishvnath and Others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that now parties have entered into compromise, therefore, this Court may please to quash the proceeding for which learned A.G.A. has no objection.
4. Under such facts and circumstances, learned counsel for the applicants is directed to file compromise deed dated 07.09.2023 alongwith application before the trial Court for verification.

In case any such application is filed alongwith compromise deed dated 07.09.2023 within two weeks from today, trial court shall fix a date for the verification of the compromise entered into between the parties within four weeks and after verification of compromise, trial Court shall send a report to this Court forthwith.
5.
List this case on 17.11.2023 before appropriate Bench.
6. Till then, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the above case.
7. This case shall not be treated tied up or part heard to this Bench."

4. Pursuant to order dated 04.10.2023, compromise has been verified by the trial Court vide order dated 12.10.2023 and the same has been received to this Court from Civil Judge(J.D.)/F.T.C.(Crime against Women), Jalaun at Urai on 01.11.2023.
5.

entities.text: Civil Judge(J.D.)/F.T.C.(Crime against Women), Jalaun at Urai
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2 has not objected the aforesaid facts and submitted that in case proceedings against the applicants is quashed, he would have no objection.
6.
In view of the facts and circumstances of the case, the applicants and opposite party no. 2 do not want to pursue the case any further as stated by them.
The matter has been mutually settled between the parties, therefore, no useful purpose would be served in proceeding with the matter further.
